steps.title: Define Application Metadata
steps.description: Create root metadata setting app name to '3D UI Lab' and package namespace to 'com.threeduilab.app'.

steps.title: Configure Build Environment
steps.description: Configure build.gradle with correct compile SDK 34, min SDK 21, and target SDK 34 using strict Java 8 compatibility.

steps.title: Establish Android Manifest Requirements
steps.description: Implement AndroidManifest.xml specifying launcher activity and standard system Material Theme.

steps.title: Create 3D Perspective Layout View
steps.description: Implement ThreeDCardView Custom FrameLayout mapping multi-axis touch gestures to custom Matrix rotation using Android graphics Camera.

steps.title: Create 3D Solid Polygon Renderer
steps.description: Implement high-performance custom drawing view for Polyhedrons using native Canvas with depth-buffer sorting logic.

steps.title: Establish Fibonacci Distribution Model
steps.description: Integrate math-driven Fibonacci sphere point cloud distribution inside ThreeDCubeView to project stunning interactive 3D particle clouds.

steps.title: Design Interactive Control Panel Layout
steps.description: Create activity_main.xml consisting of responsive mode switchers, dynamic parameter sliders, and theme customizers.

steps.title: Connect User Interactions with 3D Core
steps.description: Develop core controller logic inside MainActivity.java to update focal perspective, speed parameters, and spin velocities.

steps.title: Implement High-Tech Accent Theme Shifters
steps.description: Integrate live cosmetic theme listeners mapping custom neon green, cosmic blue, gold, and red accents instantly across both 3D engines.

steps.title: Perform Strict Verification
steps.description: Verify code compatibility ensuring Java 8 structures are strictly adhered to, eliminating lambdas and streams.

steps.title: Validate Android Namespace Integrity
steps.description: Double check standard XML namespaces inside layout and manifest, ensuring all attributes are correctly referenced.

steps.title: Building 3D UI Lab
steps.description: Execute gradle compilation tasks for assembly debugging to verify build success on AGP 8.3.2 and Gradle 8.5.
